---
name: Research question or hypothesis
about: Propose a source-linked research review; not patient care or a validated discovery
---

## Research question and classification
Hypothesis / preclinical finding / human observational finding / clinical trial result / established guidance (choose and justify).

## Public sources and identifiers
Links, dates, study IDs, corrections, rights or restrictions. Do not include patient data or confidential material.

## Mechanism and evidence context
Model/species or human population, comparison and endpoint. What is known versus proposed? Include negative findings and alternative explanations.

## Claimed result and uncertainty
Effect, denominator, follow-up, uncertainty and adverse effects, if actually reported. Otherwise write unknown. Trial completion is not proof of success.

## Review needed and conflicts
Scientific, clinical, statistical, privacy and licensing review; relevant conflicts. Do not propose self-experimentation or personal treatment.

## Requested bounded contribution
One reviewable task and its acceptance criteria. This proposal does not confer approval or clinical authority.
